BiblicalUsage: Aharah — Achrach in the Hebrew — was the third son of Benjamin, after Bela the firstborn and Ashbel the second.
TheologicalSignificance: The record gives me his name and nothing more, and I will not pretend otherwise. The tribe kept its sons' names, and the Chronicler kept the tribe's.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
